shadowSentences: I love to read books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I enjoy cooking new recipes on the weekends.
Traveling to new places gives me a sense of adventure.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often go hiking with friends to enjoy nature.
Learning a new language can be both challenging and rewarding.
Watching movies is a fun way to spend my evenings.
I think volunteering can make a positive impact on the community.
Finding balance between work and leisure is crucial for happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about healthy eating.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your personal experience with healthy eating?
Q2: What challenges do you face in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of healthy eating?
Q4: What advice would you give someone looking to eat healthier?
